newsitem.title: USA: Koch Industries unit enters retail meat deal.
newsitem.headline: Koch Industries unit enters retail meat deal.

text.p: Koch Agriculture Co, a unit of Koch Industries Inc, said it has entered a joint venture with Flint Hills Foods Inc to market processed and fully cooked meats to retail and food service distributors.

Concept Foods Inc, the operating firm created by the venture, will operate two processing plants in northeast Kansas that will produce Flint Hills Foods Inc products. Concept was formed by the merging of Koch Beef Co, a unit of Koch Agriculture, with Flint Hills Foods.
Flint Hills Foods, based in Alma, Kan., produces and markets portion-controlled and pre-cooked meats, primarily beef, to retail and food service industries. It also produces the Alma Cheese brand.

Koch Beef Co owns ranches and commercial feedyards. Koch Agriculture's other businesses include nitrogen fertilizers; corn seed biotechnology; grain handling, processing, storage and merchandising; and feed processing and marketing.

Koch Industries, the second-largest privately held company in the United States, is involved in the oil and gas industries, as well as in agriculture, chemicals, chemical technology products, hard minerals, real estate, and financial investments.
